name: Silithus
summary: Silithus is a desolate, wind-scoured desert located in the far southwestern corner of Kalimdor. Beneath its arid sands lie vast colonies of insectoid silithid and the ancient ruins of Ahn'Qiraj, sealed a millennium ago behind the formidable Scarab Wall. Today, the druids of the Cenarion Circle maintain an embattled vigil against creeping swarms, doomsday cultists.

sections.title: The Desert Frontier
sections.body: Reaching Silithus requires navigating through the primeval jungle of Un'Goro Crater and ascending a wide, rocky pass nestled in its northwestern corner. The transition is stark: lush primordial growth vanishes into a vast expanse of shifting dunes, jagged stone, and unnatural towering hives. Water is virtually nonexistent, and the winds carry the hum of insect wings and the whispering sands. The Cenarion Circle maintains Cenarion Hold near the center of the desert, serving as the sole bastion of civilization and shelter for travelers, researchers, and warriors braving the hostile wastes.

sections.title: Echoes of the Shifting Sands
sections.body: A thousand years ago, this arid expanse served as the battlefield for the War of the Shifting Sands. An allied army of night elves and great dragonflights fought desperately to drive back the Qiraji, an insidious insectoid empire spawned from the ancient Aqiri civilization. When total victory proved impossible, the defenders sealed the swarms within their stronghold using the Scarab Wall and the enchanted Scarab Dais. While the monumental gates held, subterranean tunnels allowed the beast-like silithids to burrow out, establishing sprawling colonies such as Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal throughout the sands.

sections.title: A Converging Storm
sections.body: The apocalyptic Twilight's Hammer cult has entrenched itself across several fortified outposts, summoning elemental terrors and venerating the dark power slumbering beneath Ahn'Qiraj. Cenarion Circle observers monitor the desert's spreading silithid colonies and the ancient threat behind the Scarab Wall.

faq.q: How do I get to Silithus on foot?
faq.answer: Travel to the northwestern corner of Un'Goro Crater. Near the serpentine river bend, between two prominent natural stone pillars, an inclined dirt roadway leads up through the mountainous crater wall directly into the Silithus desert.

The Scarab Wall is a massive, enchanted barrier in the south of Silithus. It was erected a thousand years ago by the night elves and the dragonflights during the War of the Shifting Sands to imprison the malevolent Qiraji empire within Ahn'Qiraj.

Cenarion Hold is an outpost established and run by the Cenarion Circle. Its druids and allied guardians observe the encroaching silithid swarms, investigate ancient ruins, and welcome neutral travelers of both the Alliance and Horde.

faq.q: What are the giant insect mounds across the zone?
faq.answer: They are the major subterranean hives of the silithids: Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal. Each hive is a sprawling network of tunnels housing distinct castes of insectoid creatures serving the wills locked behind Ahn'Qiraj.

faq.q: What is the Twilight's Hammer doing here?
aliases: why is twilight's hammer in silithus
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer cult maintains several fortified bases in Silithus, including the Twilight Base Camp and Twilight Post. They conduct foul rituals to summon elementals and worship the ancient, malevolent entities entombed behind the Scarab Wall.

angles.text: As the heart of Cenarion Circle operations in southern Kalimdor, Silithus calls upon druids to stem the corruption of the land and confront the unnatural broods threatening nature's balance.
The arid rocks and insect tunnels of Silithus host some of the richest Thorium deposits in the world, including rare ooze-covered veins hidden within the silithid hives.
Despite the harsh desert terrain, rare botanical wonders flourish here, including Mountain Silversage, Dreamfoil, Sungrass, and the exceptionally prized Black Lotus.
Silithus is the grim resting ground where your ancestors bled during the War of the Shifting Sands, sacrificing thousands to seal the gates of Ahn'Qiraj.
